reason: The flora says the leaflets are 'lanceolate to ovate'. Lanceolate (PATO_0001877) running to ovate (FLOPO_0991024, a temporary class) is the right continuum on the leaflet.

'The smooth keel' is the keel of the upper glume, and the quality 'smooth' is said of the keel. The whole that holds the keel (the glume) is left out, but leaving it out does not make the statement false.

fix: In 'inserted at base of X', the stamens are attached to X, and 'base' only says where on X. The relation should point to X (here the corolla tube), with base as the position. It should not point to a bare 'plant organ base' (FLOPO_0985024).
reason: The stamens are inserted on the corolla tube. The relation target 'plant organ base' leaves out which organ they are attached to.

fix: In a corolla with fused petals (sympetalous), 'lobes' that follow 'Corolla ...; tube ...; limb ...' are corolla lobes. They should not be mapped to petal.
reason: Trigonotis (Boraginaceae) has a corolla with fused petals. The suborbicular lobes are corolla lobes, not free petals.
The flora says the pedicel is shorter than the sepals. The quality is decreased length, measured against the sepals.

fix: 'Scarcely X' or 'hardly X' means almost not X. It should be read as a negation or as a 'barely' qualifier, never as a plain positive X.
reason: The flora says the exothecial cells are 'scarcely thickened', meaning hardly thickened. The annotation says plainly that they are thickened.
The flora says the leaves are alternate. The quality is alternate placement.

fix: In 'abaxially ..., adaxially ..., not X', the negated X belongs to the adaxial surface. The surface slot has to be carried over to the negation.

The flora says the inflorescences are up to 22 cm long. A range with only an upper limit is right.

fix: In 'étamines ... unis en tube inclus, plus rarement ± exsert', the words 'inclus' and 'exsert' are masculine singular. They agree with 'tube', so they describe the staminal tube, not the stamens. 'Plus rarement' (more rarely) marks a less common alternative, not an approximate value.
reason: The flora says the staminal tube is usually included and only rarely somewhat exserted. The annotation says the stamens are exserted, which changes both the part and how common the state is.

target: lateral sepal, fused with the base of the gynostemium (column)
fix: When a sentence begins with a position word such as 'lateral', 'dorsal' or 'inner', that word restricts the bearer and must fill the position slot.
reason: Only the lateral sepals are fused with the column. Saying it of all sepals, which includes the dorsal sepal, is false.
The flora says the stamen fascicles stand opposite the petals. The quality is opposite, relative to the petals.

target: oblong-lanceolate (oblong to lanceolate, PATO_0000946 to PATO_0001877) or oblanceolate (PATO_0002330)
fix: When a hyphenated compound such as 'oblong-lanceolate' is one of the alternatives in an 'or' list, it must be kept whole as a continuum. It should not be cut to its first word.
reason: The first alternative was reduced to 'oblong', so 'lanceolate' is lost and a shape that is merely oblong is wrongly allowed.
'Aplati latéralement' means the style is flattened from the sides. The quality laterally compressed matches.

fix: In 'A-B to C', the range runs from the compound A-B to C. A continuum built only inside the hyphen leaves out the real far end.
reason: The annotation covers only cuneate running to spatulate and leaves out 'to obovate', which is the other end of the range the flora gives.

fix: When the first item of an 'X-Y, A, or B' list is a hyphenated compound, keep it as one alternative and keep the 'or' list as a whole.
reason: Only oblong running to ovate is annotated. The flora also gives oblong and lanceolate as alternatives, and on its own this annotation gives the shape too narrowly.
The flora says the bracteole is pubescent. PATO_0001320 'pubescent hair' is defined in PATO as a pilosity quality (covered with short hairs).

fix: In 'lower surface ..., not X', the negation is restricted to that surface and must carry the surface slot. 'Not obviously X' is a weakened negation, not a full one.

fix: In 'corolla ..., its narrow lobes ...', the word 'its' points back to the corolla. Such lobes should not be mapped to leaf lamina lobe.
reason: The acutish lobes belong to the corolla. They are not lobes of the leaf.
